title: ai-catalogue: its unmet T53 requirements, R39
prior_work: Meet every unmet mark in build/requirements/ai-catalogue.md (R39), each with a test that fails with the change reverted. Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: R39 needs the release to carry a real seed payload signed by Bob's catalogue signing key. Neither exists, and this job cannot make either. (1) Signing is Bob's sitting 2 on catalogue-keys.html with his offline key (K5625, K5751, K5753: 'when ai-catalogue's seed payload exists'). No session can sign it, and a throwaway-signed seed would be refused once CATALOGUE_KEYS holds Bob's lines. (2) CATALOGUE_KEYS on tranche still holds the test-fixture lines. Swapping in Bob's lines is signatures' T53-592 (completion round), not this module's path. (3) The seed's provider data must be real facts with grade, source, date, quote and page (R1, R11, R22, P21 K5755). No evidence for any real provider is recorded in the repo, and writing it would be guessing. (4) Gate verdicts wait on Bob's pass marks (K5475, AD13), so a real seed would offer nothing ('offers the seed's entries' cannot hold yet). The mechanism is already merged and tested: loadSeed verifies by R33 and R36, holds the payload as source seed, answers NOT_NEWER, leaves a bad-signature seed unavailable (channel.test.mjs R39 tests). This is the same P19 deferral as K5674, and nothing has changed since. Nothing was changed on the branch. To unblock: (a) T53-592 lands Bob's keys in CATALOGUE_KEYS; (b) someone records the evidenced provider data for the seed, or Bob rules a seed of zero entries; (c) Bob signs the R51 statement in sitting 2 and hands back the armored signature. Then restart this job to embed the seed and its load at start.
